texts.title_text: Chad Gilbert, lead guitarist for New Found Glory, died peacefully in his sleep at 45 on September 20.
texts.slide_1_text: His wife Lisa Cimorelli confirmed he was surrounded by loved ones during his final moments.
texts.slide_2_text: The musician battled cancer for over three years, remaining active with his band until recently.
texts.slide_3_text: He underwent multiple surgeries including removal of half a liver and an adrenal gland.
texts.slide_4_text: His condition progressed from adrenal cancer to Stage 4 adrenocortical carcinoma that spread to his brain.
